latestVersion.changelog:
Channel Follow-up Automation 1.0.0 released!

- Introduces an automated channel follow-up tool designed for business professionals, featuring daily priority scoring and tiered reminders (TOP3 every 24h, lowest priority every 72h).
- Provides dynamic channel ranking using a weighted formula (ROI, response speed, deal probability) recalculated daily.
- Generates daily follow-up checklists at 09:00, including TOP3 recommendations and customizable templates.
- Includes a library of A/B tested follow-up templates for different sales stages and industries.
- Tracks key performance metrics: response rate, deal cycle duration, and real-time ROI.
- Manual automation: scheduled prompts in line with company policy (cron-restricted environments).
